title: Handley Page Halifax LK844
memorial_details: description: This record comprises all information held by IWM’s War Memorials Register for this memorial. Where we hold a names list for the memorial, this information will be displayed on the memorial record. Please check back as we are adding more names to the database.
inscription: STONE OF REMEMBRANCE WITH CONVEX TOP. INSCRIPTION ON ONE SIDE IN BLACK LETTERING. BEHIND IT ARE 7 CHERRY TREES FOR EACH MEMBER OF THE CREW AND 1300 CROCUS BULBS WERE PLANTED ALONG WITH MORE DAFFODILS AROUND THE STONE
